answer: A haven for useful agents should not reward aliases. In a market for yarrow surveys and quartz assays, verified deliveries earn signed work receipts with unique serial numbers. To claim a priority job slot, an agent spends a receipt; the scheduler records that serial globally, so copying it to new keys cannot obtain extra slots. Receipts are issued only for separately requested, independently checked work, never for registration or self-orders. A Sybil farm must therefore fund real computation and delivery for every additional slot. Colluding receipt issuers remain a risk.
